citation: Rappaport, *Wireless Communications: Principles and Practice*, 2nd ed., §4.6.2 (Eq. 4.52)
source_tool: Closed-form expansion of Rappaport Eq. 4.52 with breakpoint d_b = 4·h_t·h_r·f/c, evaluated at IEEE-754 double precision; c = 299792458 m/s.
notes: Below the breakpoint the model collapses to FSPL — this fixture covers both regimes (50 m short link is below breakpoint, 5/15 km links are above).
Phase 2 of the audit replaces these with Rappaport §4.10 worked examples and an independent reference.

vectors.description: Short link below breakpoint — falls back to FSPL
Long-range scenario well above breakpoint at 2.4 GHz
